title: Green Figure and Black Serpent
description: A surreal psychedelic scene features a large green one-eyed humanoid figure in an ornate robe holding a massive black serpent. The background shows a glowing red sun or portal in a swirling purple sky, flanked by colorful diagonal beams, floating Victorian-style houses, and multiple framed silhouette figures of a girl in a dress arranged in top and bottom borders.
prompt: Surreal psychedelic artwork with a large green one-eyed humanoid creature wearing an ornate green robe, holding a thick black serpent that coils around its body. The creature stands in a dark landscape with roots and red flowers. Behind it is a glowing red celestial body in a swirling purple vortex sky, with colorful diagonal beams of blue, yellow, and red. Floating gothic houses and clouds appear in the background. The composition is framed by multiple white-bordered panels at the top and bottom containing repeated silhouettes of a girl in a Victorian dress, flowers, and clouds. Dark fantasy aesthetic, detailed linework.
